articles.title: PM hails Jabotinsky's enduring legacy at state memorial ceremony
articles.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivered a speech at the state memorial ceremony for the late Ze'ev Jabotinsky. Addressing those who uphold Jabotinsky's legacy, Netanyahu likely emphasized themes central to Revisionist Zionism and Israeli national identity. This event underscores the historical and ideological foundations influencing current Israeli leadership and policy, relevant for understanding international political dynamics and leadership styles.

articles.title: Japan ramps up defences amid concerns about China's 'military activities'
articles.summary: Japan is undertaking its most significant defence transformation since World War II, strategically moving away from its post-war pacifist constitution. This reorientation is a direct response to China's growing influence and changing regional security dynamics. The shift signals Japan's intent to play a more active role in its own defence and regional stability, with profound implications for international power balances.

articles.title: Trump Drops Shipping Transit Fee, Says Hormuz Strait ‘Open to All Except Iran’
articles.summary: President Trump assured that the vital Strait of Hormuz is open for international shipping, clarifying that an earlier order to block Iranian ports specifically targets Iranian vessels. Non-Iranian ships can pass freely through the crucial waterway. This statement follows U.S. military action to restore order in the region, emphasizing pressure on Iran amidst escalating tensions concerning maritime access and security.

articles.title: One misstep away: Pakistan’s Iran tightrope faces its toughest test

articles.title: Iran’s IRGC claims missile strikes on US military bases in Bahrain as crypto markets reel
articles.summary: Attacks on Sheikh Isa Air Base and Fifth Fleet assets in the Persian Gulf have significantly rattled regional stability. articles.title: US deploys explosive drone boats in combat against Iran for first time
articles.summary: The United States military has deployed explosive drone boats in combat for the first time, targeting an Iranian submarine and a naval facility. This significant tactical development occurred during the ongoing 2026 Iran war. The operation highlights the increasing integration of autonomous unmanned systems in modern naval warfare, showcasing advanced capabilities against hostile maritime assets and marking a new era in military strategy and technology.

articles.title: Navy Ex-Secretary John Phelan Issues Dire Warning to Hegseth, Congress
articles.summary: Former Navy Secretary John Phelan is urging Congress and the Pentagon to support the Navy in enhancing its operational efficiency. Phelan advocates for the Navy to become better, faster, and smarter to effectively counter U.S. adversaries. This call highlights the critical need for strategic improvements to maintain naval superiority and national security, as detailed in his new op-ed.
